import scipy.optimize as so
t=df['t'].values; P=df['P'].values; y=df['dP_dt'].values
L=np.log(P); lt=np.log(t); one=np.ones_like(P)
names=['1','P','PL','1/P','L','t','t/P','lt/P','lt','S/P','S','SP','tS/P','C/P','C','t*C/P']
def cols(w,ph):
    S=np.sin(w*t+ph); C=np.cos(w*t+ph)
    return [one,P,P*L,1/P,L,t,t/P,lt/P,lt,S/P,S,S*P,t*S/P,C/P,C,t*C/P]
def fitw(idx):
    def model(p):
        A=np.column_stack([cols(p[0],p[1])[i] for i in idx])
        co=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)[0]
        return A@co, co
    best=None
    for w0 in [0.30,0.32,0.34]:
        for ph0 in [1.5,2.5,3.5]:
            r=so.least_squares(lambda p: model(p)[0]-y,[w0,ph0])
            v=np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(y)
            if best is None or v<best[0]: best=(v,r.x,model(r.x)[1])
    return best

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    b,c,d,e,f,g,h,k,m,w = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7],params[8],params[9]
    s=np.sin(w*t); cc=np.cos(w*t)
    return b*t + c*P*np.log(P) + (d + e*t + f*np.log(t) + (g + h*t)*s + (k + m*t)*cc)/P
